facades.name: Amstel front
facades.note: Cropped to the 9.4 m Amstel front (alongM: the silhouette's viewer-left edge is the shell's east side 0.47 m beyond the front's east corner; the turret and the Muntplein front beyond it are separate walls). Bands as the model's rows: the three round-arched shop windows; the oculus in the Amstel 2 door pediment (the door itself is solid wood); three first-storey and three second-storey axes; on the mansard the flat dormer (ten lights between posts narrower than 0.3 m, one ribbon) and the stone gable dormer's arched window over the west axis. Axes (2022 crop, px/50.2 from the east end): the door oculus 1.2 m, the first windows 2.5, the first arch with the flat dormer 3.5-3.9, the middle windows 5.2 and arch 5.7 (0.5 m apart), the west axis 7.9 (windows, arch and gable).

facades.name: Muntplein front
facades.note: Cropped to the 5.0 m Muntplein front (alongM: the silhouette's viewer-left edge is the Amstel front's east end, 4.65 m before the front's north corner). Bands as the model's rows: the round-arched shop window and the glazed shop door; the oculus over the door; each storey's pair of lights either side of a carved mullion narrower than 0.3 m (2025 crop: 0.26 m), one opening by the ribbon convention; the gable dormer's arched window. Axes (2025 crop): the shop window 1.6 m, the paired windows and the gable 2.5-2.6, the door and oculus 3.7.
